DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

Given your age, the sudden onset of position-dependent vertigo, and the absence of other neurological or auditory symptoms, this clinical picture strongly points to BPPV. I am confident in this diagnosis based on the history provided.
